title: Sleeping in the Castle at Český Krumlov
description: Stayed here for one night. Once the noisy crowds disappeared, everything became incredibly quiet. The whole town lit up like a scene from a fairy tale.
coverAlt: Night view over the illuminated rooftops of Český Krumlov, with St. Vitus Church and the Vltava river beneath a starry sky

images.alt: Český Krumlov's old town glowing at night, with St. Vitus Church, clustered red roofs, and the Vltava river beneath a deep blue sky
images.caption: Český Krumlov after dark — the best view from a night in the castle.
